events.text: Elder: Welcome to Willowbrook, young hero!|Wild beasts roam the eastern fields,|and something stirs in the northern cave...
Villager: The well water is cold and sweet.|Try the shop to the east!
Farmer: My flowers bloom nicely|even in this gentle rain.
Girl: I saw a shiny box near the trees!|Hee hee.
The village Crystal was stolen by a cave beast! Recover it from the northern cave.
East Field: Monsters ahead! Press Space to attack.
A cozy cottage. The door is locked.
